name: loenn-mcp
description: Celeste map editor for AI agents: read, edit, validate, preview and generate .bin maps.
long_description: Reads and writes Celeste .bin maps directly (lossless), with timestamped backups on every write, semantic diffs, Lönn/Rysy launching, Sprite Fusion and Summer Engine gray-box rooms, a shared C# PCG core, seleCte whole-level generation, and a live link to a running Everest game. Needs uv on the machine: the host installs Python and the dependencies from pyproject.toml.

workspace.title: Celeste mod folder
workspace.description: Root of the Everest mod to edit (for example Celeste/Mods/MyMap). Map paths in every tool are relative to it.
